summary_1line: Grief-stricken Yudhishthira resolves to renounce his kingdom after the war, but Arjuna rebukes him, urging him to rule and fulfill royal duty.

image_candidates.scene_text: Yudhishthira, weary and grief-stricken after the war, declares before Arjuna that he will abandon his kingdom and retreat to the forest.
Arjuna, fierce and intense, licks the corners of his mouth and sharply rebukes Yudhishthira for wanting to renounce the throne after winning the war.
